purpose: Seventh independently reviewed batch. Each fact is supported by a continuous quotation from a current first-party airline page. A conditional channel is a documented policy route, never availability or final carriage acceptance.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — direct reading of official airline page

facts.condition_scope: Small pets under 6 kg are described as accepted in cabin, subject to route, quota, documentation and container rules. The page is inconsistent about whether the 6 kg basis includes the container, so no structured dog-only threshold may be inferred.
facts.finder_effect: Air Algérie cabin is a documented conditional route; the 6 kg wording remains descriptive and must not become a dog-only threshold.
facts.quote: only small pets under 6 kg are accepted on board
facts.locator: Travel with pets → Pets travelling in cabin

facts.condition_scope: The hold route applies when cabin weight or container limits are exceeded, with route, aircraft, documentation and container restrictions. Hold is prohibited to and from the United Kingdom.
facts.finder_effect: Air Algérie hold is conditional and must be suppressed on United Kingdom sectors.
facts.quote: your pet must be transported in the hold
facts.locator: Travel with pets → Pets travel in the hold

facts.condition_scope: Cats and dogs other than French category 1 and 2 dogs; animal plus container below 8 kg; quota, container, route and documentation rules apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Austral cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: le poids de l'animal + son contenant doit être inférieur à 8 kg

facts.condition_scope: Cats and dogs over 8 kg; capacity, breed, route, container and documentation restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Austral hold is a documented conditional route, not guaranteed acceptance.
facts.quote: Le transport en soute est obligatoire

facts.condition_scope: Cabin accepts dogs, cats and listed small pets, subject to quotas, route, behavior, container, age and documentation rules.
facts.finder_effect: Air Caraïbes cabin is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: sont uniquement les chiens, chats

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats only, subject to airline acceptance, quota, route, weight, breed, container and documentation rules; snub-nosed animals are excluded from hold.
facts.finder_effect: Air Caraïbes hold is conditional and does not apply to brachycephalic dogs.
facts.quote: sont les chiens et chats uniquement (sous réserve d'acceptation de la compagnie).

facts.condition_scope: Freight is the documented route for other animals and for large dogs that cannot use the maximum passenger-hold container; booking and station approval remain required.
facts.finder_effect: Air Caraïbes cargo is conditional and is not a general passenger-hold answer.
facts.quote: devront voyager par FRET.
facts.locator: Animaux en soute → Règles de transport

facts.condition_scope: Vaccinated dogs and cats accompanied by their owner; only the four listed Papeete, Los Angeles and Paris sectors; combined animal-and-container weight up to 8 kg, quota and documentation rules apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Tahiti Nui cabin is route-scoped and must not be generalized to the whole network.
facts.quote: Air Tahiti Nui accepte le transport en cabine des chiens et chats vaccinés accompagnés de leur propriétaire et uniquement sur les vols suivants :

facts.condition_scope: Air Tahiti Nui Cargo carries dogs and cats on listed stations when cabin transport is unavailable; freight booking, route, crate and health requirements apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Tahiti Nui cargo is a documented conditional freight route; it must not be labeled accompanied checked baggage.
facts.quote: Si, en revanche, votre animal ne peut pas être transporté en cabine, il peut certainement être transporté par fret, dans la soute de l’appareil.
facts.locator: Vous souhaitez faire voyager votre animal de compagnie ?

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet dogs are freight-only. The separately stated cabin exception is limited to guide dogs and is outside this verdict.
facts.finder_effect: Aircalin cabin is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: Le transport des animaux s’effectue en fret uniquement.

facts.condition_scope: The official page defines animal carriage as freight-only; its later reference to the aircraft hold describes operational handling, not accompanied checked-pet service.
facts.finder_effect: Aircalin passenger hold is not offered for ordinary pet dogs; cargo remains the documented route.
facts.quote: Le transport des animaux s’effectue en fret uniquement.

facts.condition_scope: Freight-only carriage; advance notification, station, route, health, import and container requirements apply.
facts.finder_effect: Aircalin cargo is the documented conditional route for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: Le transport des animaux s’effectue en fret uniquement.

facts.condition_scope: Animal plus container no more than 8 kg; route, breed, health, documentation, quota and container restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Corsair cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: Le transport peut s'effectuer en cabine

facts.condition_scope: Animal plus container no more than 50 kg; route, breed, health, documentation and container restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Corsair hold is conditional with a 50 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: Le transport s'effectue en soute

facts.condition_scope: Freight is required above the 50 kg combined animal-and-container passenger-hold ceiling; route, breed and cargo acceptance rules still apply.
facts.finder_effect: Corsair cargo is conditional for dogs above the passenger-hold weight ceiling.
facts.quote: Au-delà de 50 kg, le transport devra s'effectuer par le fret.

facts.condition_scope: One dog or cat per passenger, with the carrier and all route, weight, breed, health, reservation and documentation conditions satisfied.
facts.finder_effect: French Bee cabin is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: En cabine vous avez le droit de transporter un chien ou chat par passager.
facts.locator: Quel type de sac pour mon animal en cabine ?

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats may travel in hold subject to weight, size, breed, crate, route and documentation conditions; brachycephalic animals are excluded.
facts.finder_effect: French Bee hold is conditional and does not apply to brachycephalic dogs.
facts.quote: Ils peuvent voyager en soute sous certaines conditions
facts.locator: Puis-je faire voyager mon animal avec moi dans l’avion ?

facts.condition_scope: Selected domestic animals may be accepted in cabin after reservation approval; combined weight, container, route, species and documentation restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Iberia Express cabin is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: podrán ser aceptados para el transporte en cabina determinados animales domésticos

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats may be accepted in hold subject to a 45 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling, advance request, route, breed, connection, quota and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: Iberia Express hold is conditional and excludes brachycephalic dogs.
facts.quote: pueden ser aceptados como equipaje en bodega

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 8 kg including the bag, subject to a four-animal flight quota, advance request, container, behavior and documentation rules.
facts.finder_effect: La Compagnie cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-bag ceiling.
facts.quote: vos compagnons, jusqu’à 8kg, sac compris, (chiens et chats)

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet transport is cabin-only; passenger hold is explicitly not offered.
facts.finder_effect: La Compagnie hold is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: Seul le transport en cabine est autorisé, le transport d’animaux en soute n’est pas proposé.

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats only; under-8-kg cabin policy, quota, route, reservation, documentation and container conditions apply. Cabin is unavailable on listed destinations.
facts.finder_effect: Luxair cabin is conditional and route-scoped.
facts.quote: welcome them on board either in cabin
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → General information and regulations

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats only; aircraft quota, route, reservation, documentation and container conditions apply. Hold is unavailable to and from Paris Charles de Gaulle and on other listed destinations.
facts.finder_effect: Luxair hold is conditional and route-scoped.
facts.quote: welcome them on board either in cabin or in hold
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → General information and regulations

intentionally_unset.reason: The reviewed page mentions freight for United Kingdom sectors but does not establish a general cargo offer for the whole network.
The reviewed page mentions freight for other animal types but does not establish a distinct general cargo route for ordinary pet dogs.
The official material describes cabin and Air Tahiti Nui Cargo; it does not establish accompanied checked-pet service as a separate channel.
The two current passenger FAQs establish cabin and hold only; no separate unaccompanied freight offer was proven.
The page says some non-PETC/AVIH animals may be handled as merchandise in some cases, but does not establish a general dog cargo answer.
The reviewed page proves cabin and the absence of passenger hold, but says nothing decisive about separately booked cargo.
The reviewed passenger page establishes cabin and hold only, not a distinct unaccompanied freight offer.
